scope: M9A production-mesh and adaptive half-wavelength validation

rejected_coarser_mesh.reason: The DISTORTIONAL stress differs by 1.18419 percent from the 7.5 mm reference, exceeding the frozen 0.5 percent production-mesh gate.

finer_mesh_limit.reason: For these subdivision patterns the classical full basis becomes numerically rank-deficient (condition number approximately 3e16 to 5e16). Stable least-squares family participation remains DISTORTIONAL, but reconstruction residuals exceed the 1e-8 automatic gate. A finer mesh is not presumed superior when the modal basis loses numerical rank.

mesh_study.production_rule: 10 mm is the validated practical recommendation for this reference C section only. Production analyses must supply an explicitly finer reference_strip_width_mm and pass stress, wavelength, family, reconstruction, and shared-vertex MAC gates; no global finest mesh is hard-coded.

wavelength_study.refinement_method: Geometric midpoints are inserted on both sides of each detected LOCAL/DISTORTIONAL critical neighborhood. A falling LOCAL/DISTORTIONAL boundary minimum expands the corresponding range geometrically. GLOBAL boundary behavior is diagnostic and remains M8B-owned.
